en: Paṭṭhānapakaraṇa:
Dhammānuloma (1), Dukatikapaṭṭhānapāḷi (3) 3.8.
The Group on Hindrances (Nīvaraṇagocchaka), within the Wholesome Triad (Kusalattika)
3.8.1. The Dyad on Hindrances, the Triplet on the Wholesome, and the Root Condition:
Dependent on a wholesome state that is not a hindrance, a wholesome state that is not a hindrance arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, one; in the case of the object condition, one … pe … in the case of the non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.
(In the co-nascent section … pe … and in the inquiry section, it is one in every instance.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is a hindrance, an unwholesome state that is a hindrance arises by way of the root condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is an hindrance, an unwholesome state that is not an hindrance arises by way of root-condition.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is an hindrance, both unwholesome states that are hindrances and unwholesome states that are not hindrances arise by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of the root condition, nine; in the case of the object condition, nine ... pe ... in the case of the non-disappearance condition, nine. (Abbreviated. Negative: Not-root.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is an *nīvaraṇa* (hindrance), an unwholesome state that is an *nīvaraṇa* arises by way of the not-root condition (*nahetupaccaya*): dependent on the hindrance of doubt (*vicikicchā-nīvaraṇa*) and the hindrance of restlessness (*uddhacca-nīvaraṇa*), the hindrance of ignorance (*avijjā-nīvaraṇa*) arises.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is not an *nīvaraṇa*, an unwholesome state that is an *nīvaraṇa* arises by way of the not-root condition: dependent on the aggregates associated with doubt and associated with restlessness, the hindrance of ignorance arises.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is both an *nīvaraṇa* and not an *nīvaraṇa*, an unwholesome state that is an *nīvaraṇa* arises...

Not-root condition: dependent on the hindrance of doubt, the hindrance of restlessness, and the associated aggregates, there is the hindrance of ignorance. (Abbreviated. In the "not-root" category there are three;
in the "not-predominance" category, nine; in the "not-prenascence" category, nine ... pe ... in the "not-kamma" category, three ... pe ... in the "not-dissociation" category, nine. (Abbreviated.)
(In the section on co-nascence... and in the section on association, there are nine in all.
An unwholesome state that is a hindrance is a condition, by way of root-condition, for an unwholesome state that is a hindrance. (Abbreviated. There are three in the case of root;

nine in the case of object; nine in the case of predominance... pe... nine in the case of repetition; three in the cases of kamma, nutriment, faculty, jhāna, and path; nine in the case of association... pe... nine in the case of non-disappearance. (Abbreviated.)
In the absence of the root condition, nine; in the absence of the object condition, nine. (Abbreviated.
With the root condition, in the absence of the object condition, three. (Abbreviated.
In the absence of the root condition, in the presence of the object condition, nine. (Abbreviated.)
(Just as the positive, negative, positive-negative, and negative-positive methods were calculated for the section on questions in the *Kusalattika*, so too should they be calculated here.
Dependent on a non-obscuring indeterminate state, a non-obscuring indeterminate state arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there is one; under object-condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition there is one. (Abbreviated.)
(In the section on co-nascence, ... pe ... and in the section on inquiry, it is one in all cases.
3.8.2. The Dyad on the Hindrances, the Triad on the Wholesome, and the Root.
Dependent on a wholesome state that is subject to hindrances, a wholesome state subject to hindrances arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a wholesome state not subject to hindrances, a wholesome state not subject to hindrances arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there are two; under object condition there are two … pe … under non-disappearance condition there are two. (Abbreviated.)
(The "Co-arising" section ... and the "Questioning" section should also be expanded in detail.
Dependent on an unwholesome state that is subject to the hindrances, an unwholesome state subject to the hindrances arises by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root: one; under object: one ... pe ... under non-disappearance: one. (Abbreviated.)
(In the section on co-nascence as well …pe… and in the section on inquiry as well, it is the same in all cases.
Dependent on a neutral state that is subject to hindrances, a neutral state subject to hindrances arises by way of root condition.
Dependent on a neutral state not subject to hindrances, a neutral state not subject to hindrances arises by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is both an obstruction and indeterminate, and a state that is not an obstruction and indeterminate, there arises a state that is an obstruction and indeterminate by way of root-condition.

(Abbreviated. Under root-condition there are five; under object-condition two ... [and so on] ... under repetition-condition one ... [and so on] ... under result-condition five ... [and so on] ... under non-disappearance-condition five. (Abbreviated. (The "Conascent" section ...
and the "Investigation" section should also be expanded in detail. 3.8.3. The Dyad of States Associated with Obstructions; The Triplet of the Wholesome.
Dependent on a wholesome state dissociated from the hindrances, a wholesome state dissociated from the hindrances arises by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition there is one; under object condition there is one … pe … under non-disappearance condition there is one. (Abbreviated.)
(Also in the section on co-nascence …pe… and in the section on inquiry, it is one in every instance.
Dependent on an unwholesome state associated with the hindrances, there arises an unwholesome state associated with the hindrances by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root condition, one; under object condition, one …pe… under non-disappearance condition, one. (Abbreviated.)
(In the section on Co-nascence as well …pe… and in the section on the Inquiry as well, it is one in all cases.
Dependent on a neutral state dissociated from the hindrances, a neutral state dissociated from the hindrances arises by way of root-condition. (Abbreviated.
Under root-condition there is one; under object-condition there is one …pe… under non-disappearance-condition there is one. (Abbreviated.)
(In the section on co-arising, ...pe... and in the section on questions, it is the same in all cases. 3.8.4.
The Dyads on Hindrances and the Hindrance-able; the Triads on the Wholesome;
the Root.

Dependent on a wholesome state that is both subject to the hindrances and yet not itself a hindrance, there arises a wholesome state that is both subject to the hindrances and yet not itself a hindrance, by way of root condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root condition: one; under object condition: one ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition: one. (Abbreviated.
[The same applies] throughout the section on co-nascence and the section on inquiry: everywhere, one.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is both an hindrance and an object of an hindrance, there arises an unwholesome state that is both an hindrance and an object of an hindrance, by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is an object of an hindrance but is not itself an hindrance, there arises an unwholesome state that is an object of an hindrance but is not itself an hindrance, by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is both a hindrance and the object of a hindrance, and is unwholesome, there arises a state that is both a hindrance and the object of a hindrance, and is unwholesome, by way of root-condition (*hetu-paccaya*) … three. (Abbreviated.
Nine for root; nine for object … pe … nine for non-disappearance. (Abbreviated.
(In the co-nascent section … pe … and in the inquiry section, there are nine in every instance.)

Dependent on a neutral state that is both subject to hindrance and yet not itself a hindrance, there arises a neutral state that is both subject to hindrance and yet not itself a hindrance, by way of root-condition.
(Abbreviated. Under root-condition: one; under object-condition: one … pe … under non-disappearance-condition: one. (Abbreviated.
[The same applies] in the section on co-nascence … pe … and in the section on inquiry, in all cases: one.
3.8.5. The Dyads on Hindrances and Association with Hindrances; the Triplet of the Wholesome.

Dependent on an unwholesome state that is both a hindrance and associated with a hindrance, there arises an unwholesome state that is both a hindrance and associated with a hindrance, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
In the case of cause, nine; in the case of object, nine ... pe ... in the case of non-disappearance, nine. (Abbreviated.
(In the section on conascence ... pe ... and in the section on inquiry, there are nine in every instance. 3.8.6.
The Couple of the Dissociated from Hindrances and Subject to Hindrances; The Triplet of the Wholesome.
Root Condition:

Dependent on a wholesome state that is dissociated from the hindrances but subject to them (*nīvaraṇiya*), there arises a wholesome state dissociated from the hindrances but subject to them, by way of root condition.

Dependent on a wholesome state dissociated from the hindrances and not subject to them (*anīvaraṇiya*), there arises a wholesome state dissociated from the hindrances and not subject to them, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
With respect to cause, two; with respect to object, two ... pe ... with respect to non-disappearance, two. (Abbreviated.
(The sections on "conascent" and "inquiry" should also be expanded in detail.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the hindrances, subject to the hindrances, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is dissociated from the hindrances, subject to the hindrances, and indeterminate, by way of the root condition.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the hindrances, not subject to the hindrances, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is dissociated from the hindrances, not subject to the hindrances, and indeterminate, by way of root condition … three.

Dependent on a state that is dissociated from the hindrances, subject to the hindrances, and indeterminate, and a state that is dissociated from the hindrances, not subject to the hindrances, and indeterminate, there arises a state that is dissociated from the hindrances, subject to the hindrances, and indeterminate, by way of root condition. (Abbreviated.)
Under the condition of cause, five; under the condition of object, two ... [and so on] ... under the condition of repetition, one; under the condition of result, five ... [and so on] ...
under the condition of non-disappearance, five. (Abbreviated. (In the "Conascent" section ... and in the "Investigation" section, it should be expanded in all instances.
The Wholesome Triplet of the Hindrance Group is finished.
